title: 手写反向传播（拓扑排序 + VJP），并用数值梯度校验
code:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)

# ---- 一个极简 autograd ----
class Tensor:
    def __init__(self, data, _children=()):
        self.data = np.asarray(data, dtype=np.float64)
        self.grad = np.zeros_like(self.data)
        self._backward = lambda: None
        self._prev = set(_children)

    def __add__(self, other):
        other = other if isinstance(other, Tensor) else Tensor(np.asarray(other, dtype=np.float64))
        out = Tensor(self.data + other.data, (self, other))
        def _bw():
            self.grad += out.grad
            other.grad += np.sum(out.grad) if other.data.shape != out.grad.shape                           and other.data.size == 1 else out.grad
        out._backward = _bw
        return out

    def __mul__(self, other):
        other = other if isinstance(other, Tensor) else Tensor(np.asarray(other, dtype=np.float64))
        out = Tensor(self.data * other.data, (self, other))
        def _bw():
            self.grad += other.data * out.grad
            other.grad += self.data * out.grad
        out._backward = _bw
        return out

    def sum(self):
        out = Tensor(np.array([self.data.sum()]), (self,))
        def _bw():
            self.grad += np.ones_like(self.data) * out.grad.item()
        out._backward = _bw
        return out

    def backward(self):
        topo, seen = [], set()
        def build(v):
            if v not in seen:
                seen.add(v)
                for c in v._prev:
                    build(c)
                topo.append(v)
        build(self)
        self.grad = np.ones_like(self.data)
        for v in reversed(topo):
            v._backward()

# ---- 计算 y = sum((a*b + c) * a) ----
a = Tensor(rng.normal(size=(3,)))
b = Tensor(rng.normal(size=(3,)))
c = Tensor(rng.normal(size=(3,)))
y = ((a * b) + c) * a
y = y.sum()

y.backward()

print("解析梯度（autograd）:")
print("  dy/da =", np.round(a.grad, 6))
print("  dy/db =", np.round(b.grad, 6))
print("  dy/dc =", np.round(c.grad, 6))
print()

# ---- 数值梯度校验（中心差分）----
def f(av, bv, cv):
    return float(np.sum((av * bv + cv) * av))

h = 1e-6
num = {}
for name, base in [("a", a.data.copy()), ("b", b.data.copy()), ("c", c.data.copy())]:
    g = np.zeros_like(base)
    for i in range(base.size):
        old = base[i]
        aa, bb, cc = a.data.copy(), b.data.copy(), c.data.copy()
        arr = {"a": aa, "b": bb, "c": cc}[name]
        arr[i] = old + h
        f_plus = f(aa, bb, cc)
        aa, bb, cc = a.data.copy(), b.data.copy(), c.data.copy()
        arr = {"a": aa, "b": bb, "c": cc}[name]
        arr[i] = old - h
        f_minus = f(aa, bb, cc)
        g[i] = (f_plus - f_minus) / (2 * h)
        base[i] = old
    num[name] = g

print("数值梯度（中心差分）:")
for name in ("a", "b", "c"):
    print(f"  dy/d{name} =", np.round(num[name], 6))

print()
print("=== 相对误差校验 ===")
ana = {"a": a.grad, "b": b.grad, "c": c.grad}
all_ok = True
for name in ("a", "b", "c"):
    denom = np.maximum(1.0, np.abs(num[name]) + np.abs(ana[name]))
    rel = np.max(np.abs(num[name] - ana[name]) / denom)
    ok = rel < 1e-5
    all_ok &= ok
    print(f"  {name}: 最大相对误差 = {rel:.3e}  -> {'通过' if ok else '失败'}")
print()
print("全部通过:", all_ok, " <- 手写 autograd 正确性的唯一可靠验证手段")
